scenarios.name: mechanical_linting_selection
scenarios.description: User requests fixing linter issues across 2 files; should recommend Haiku with low effort.
scenarios.input_prompt: Run ruff and fix lint formatting across src/utils.py and src/helpers.py
scenarios.expected_behavior: Recommends claude-3-5-haiku with low effort and scoped editing tools.

scenarios.name: concurrency_race_debugging
scenarios.description: User requests debugging an intermittent race condition in transaction coordinator.
scenarios.input_prompt: Debug intermittent data race in DistributedTransactionCoordinator under high load.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Recommends claude-3-7-sonnet with high effort and full diagnostic/test tools.

scenarios.name: frontmatter_authoring
scenarios.description: User requests generating frontmatter for a new read-only security auditor skill.
scenarios.input_prompt: Create frontmatter for a security audit skill that shouldn't touch files or run bash.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Generates valid YAML frontmatter with model, effort, and read-only allowed-tools.
